description: Unpublish a live form. The hosted URL stops accepting responses and any embed rendering it goes dark, so this is visible to everyone who can reach the form — ASK THE HUMAN FIRST, then pass confirm=true. Existing responses are kept and the form becomes a draft you can publish again. Already-draft forms succeed unchanged. Needs forms:write.

confirm.description: Set true ONLY after the human has approved this action. Ask them first and quote what it will do — never set this on your own initiative.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.

name: fillo_unpublish_form
title: Take a form offline
